events.text:
Migration is complete. All 10 batches (400 records) are in the new CRM, and Morgan has the single report.

The batch 3 validation note flagged wrong phone numbers: the new CRM added a +1 prefix to numbers that had no country code, affecting 31 of the first 120 records and the same pattern in batches 4–10. Fourteen sales users opened records in the last 24 hours. I did not change any numbers, since I don’t have the correct country codes, and I asked Morgan how to source them.
